meaning: Classification concerns the human reconstruction, assuming the formal source checked and correct.

categories.A: Exact published theorem with checked hypotheses
categories.B: Elementary or moderately difficult independently reconstructible argument
categories.D: Unresolved human understanding or source/theorem matching

graph_semantics: all_of lists conjunctive requirements for the displayed sufficient source route. Named alternative routes are explicitly marked. A node marked conditional_endpoint is not unconditionally proved.

scopes.inherited_A_policy: Reuse only the exact recorded RX/CX/QX/SX/UX and cohomology certificate scopes; no automatic rank-four-to-rank-three or rank-two-to-rank-four transport.
scopes.not_a_complete_global_graph: Independent actual-family, rank, gap, denominator, theta and spectral branches are managed by the global audit.
